opportunities.name: Researched true ray
opportunities.objective: Prepare Deconstruction before R and test the true-damage finish threshold.
opportunities.mechanic: Three ability stacks trigger AP-scaled true damage and cause R to deal true damage to a recently deconstructed target. Shadowflame explicitly boosts low-health true damage; Cosmic reacts to true/magic damage and can help positioning before channeling. Mana and AP support the preparatory W/E/Q sequence.
opportunities.requiredState: Passive proc confirmed before R, target within beam and channel protected.
opportunities.failure: Missed setup or interruption converts the expected payoff into a short magic channel.
opportunities.test: Record R damage type after zero versus three setup stacks and above versus below 40% target health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic penetration cannot increase the researched beam's true damage.

opportunities.name: Attack refresh stack
opportunities.objective: Preserve partial Deconstruction with an occasional safer attack before the next spell.
opportunities.mechanic: Attacks refresh the passive's seven-second duration without adding stacks. RFC offers a charged attack range window and Lich Bane rewards a preceding cast; Q's slow and split geometry can keep a delayed follow-up spell accessible. The expensive attack slot must repay stacks that otherwise expire.
opportunities.requiredState: One or two partial stacks about to expire, RFC ready and safe attack range.
opportunities.failure: The attack exposes Vel'Koz to engage or an ordinary spell could have refreshed stacks more safely.
opportunities.test: Delay follow-up beyond seven seconds with versus without one attack and inspect refresh, proc and exposure.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: An attack refresh is not a new Deconstruction stack, including repeated on-hits.

ruledOut.reason: Passive explicitly says attacks refresh but do not add new stacks.

unknowns: RFC refresh delivery and researched-state duration must be observed; W charge recharge token remains unresolved.

builds.name: Researched true ray
builds.summary: Prepare Deconstruction before R and test the true-damage finish threshold.
builds.goal: Prepare Deconstruction before R and test the true-damage finish threshold.
builds.hypothesis: Three ability stacks trigger AP-scaled true damage and cause R to deal true damage to a recently deconstructed target. Shadowflame explicitly boosts low-health true damage; Cosmic reacts to true/magic damage and can help positioning before channeling. Mana and AP support the preparatory W/E/Q sequence.
testPlan: Required state: Passive proc confirmed before R, target within beam and channel protected.
Record R damage type after zero versus three setup stacks and above versus below 40% target health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missed setup or interruption converts the expected payoff into a short magic channel.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Magic penetration cannot increase the researched beam's true damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Luden's Echo, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cosmic Drive, Zhonya's Hourglass, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage and Slows by [70]% decaying over [1 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 / 2.6] second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores [20 / 22.5 / 25 / 27.5 / 30] Mana.

Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for [0.75] seconds and dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up.

Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of [450 / 700 / 925 + (1.25) × AP] magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by [20 / 20 / 20]%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by {{Spell_VelkozPassive_Name}}.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.

Vel'Koz's Abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction for [7] seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks consume them and take [(0.6) × AP + characterLevelInterpolation(35 → 180; raw flags preserved)] true damage.

Vel'Koz's Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction, but won't add new stacks.
